steps.thought: I found 3-D Man with id=1 in superhero.json. Now I need to get his superpowers from hero_power.csv which should contain the power associations.
I found that 3-D Man (hero_id=1) has power_ids 1, 18, 26, 31. Now I need to look up these power IDs in superpower.csv to get the actual superpower names.

I found 3-D Man's superpowers. From hero_power.csv, 3-D Man (hero_id=1) has power_ids 1, 18, 26, 31. From superpower.csv, these correspond to: 1=Agility, 18=Super Strength, 26=Stamina, 31=Super Speed.
